batch_node.name: rampart-20x-playground mock inventory
batch_node.description: MOCK DATA, never collected from a live system: the declared GovCloud deployment of git-serious as aws_core nodes and edges, the people and computers around it (identity_core, computing_core) and the GitHub side of its deploy path (github_core). Every entity carries dcom=design (req-rampart-20x-playground-mock-inventory-2). Account ids and ARNs are invented and use the reserved example.invalid domain. Edges are official aws_core edges only (req-rampart-20x-playground-govcloud-grid-true-5).

node.name: Authorization Boundary
node.description: The authorization boundary around the git-serious AWS account: the account and everything that runs in it. GitHub, the customers, the developer and the administrator stand outside it.
